name: Cervantes / Elena · pollarded lawn trees
trust: Three clipped trees and their order beside the lane/door approach are visible in ground and roof photos. Positions and 2.6 m heights are estimated within the existing approximate lawn outlines, not surveyed. Existing lawn rings and white kerbs retained: oblique roof views establish the relationships but do not calibrate a metric retrace. 18 November 2026: drawn as clipped trees (a round crown on a trunk, src/clipped-plants.ts roundClippedTree) instead of the generic pollarded-tree card, and re-placed through the solved roof cameras.

trees.name: Cervantes / Elena · clipped standard 1
trees.trust: Photo-supported clipped tree; position and size estimated relative to retained lawn and entrance approach. 18 November 2026: the clipped standard (round crown on a bare trunk) near the lawn's north tip, between the manhole and the lane corner: trunk cast through the solved roof cameras of ELENA-ROOF-2026-11-17 and IMG_2358 (its foot is hidden by the foreground bougainvillea) and placed by IMG_2262 against the manhole and the kerb corner; good to about 0.5 m. Its crown overhangs the lawn's north kerb as photographed (only the trunk keeps clear); the photos put the trunk 0.5-1 m further north still, beyond the modelled lawn edge (discrepancy elena-lawn-north-edge).

trees.name: Cervantes / Elena · clipped dome 2
trees.trust: Photo-supported clipped tree; position and size estimated relative to retained lawn and entrance approach. 18 November 2026: the clipped dome at the near lawn's corner by the cross path: trunk foot cast through both solved roof cameras to (-149.80, 66.56) and (-149.24, 67.55), placed between them; its crown overhangs the lane kerb as photographed, so only the trunk keeps the route clearance.

trees.name: Cervantes / Elena · clipped dome 3
trees.trust: Photo-supported clipped tree; position and size estimated relative to retained lawn and entrance approach. 18 November 2026: the clipped dome at the far lawn's north-east corner, its trunk hidden behind the near dome in ELENA-ROOF-2026-11-17: placed under the crown centre on the lawn, good to about 1 m; crown overhangs the kerb as photographed.
